text: Steenbarger: not the dip itself. Six of seven reject in_zone:ma_20, and C5 forbids buying the reaction. The shared ground is entry on proof of strength out of the pullback; I take its strict form, a daily close at a fresh closing high (close_above:high_52w_close, D), with D close_vs_swing_high_pct 2.2 and the 20-day high 0.7% away. minervini's and seow's close above bar_high is the nearest second; I accept it only where that close is also a new high. No new figure moves me to the dip. Clears when the trigger is replaced. Wrong if a two-ATR one-day fade (atr_14d 0.52, my translation of C7).
